newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran "vampire" killer lashed before public hanging.
newsitem.headline: Iran "vampire" killer lashed before public hanging.

text.p: An Iranian taxi driver dubbed the "Tehran vampire" has received the first of 900 lashes before his public hanging on Wednesday for the kidnap, rape and murder of nine girls and women, newspapers reported on Tuesday.

Gholamreza Khoshrou Kouran Kordieh, known as "the vampire" because he killed his victims at night, had been sentenced to receive 900 lashes and then be hanged from a mobile crane at the scene of his crimes in west Tehran.
"The 900 lashes sentence was confirmed by the Supreme Court...the lashes started yesterday (Monday)," the Persian daily newspaper Iran said.
Khoshrou, 28, confessed on television to kidnapping, raping and murdering nine girls and women over a four-month period earlier this year. The youngest victim was 10 years old.
"Even execution will not mitigate our pain and our wounded hearts," Iran quoted a relative of one of the victims as saying.
Relatives of the victims had demanded that Khoshrou be stoned to death, the daily Iran News reported.
Khoshrou was reported to have burned the bodies of his victims so they would not be identified.
